name: Lourna Dee
description: The Lourna Dee was a cruiser commanded by Nihil Tempest Runner Lourna Dee, who named the vessel after herself. The cruiser was outfitted with numerous systems, including heat baffling, ablative plating, and double-sealed engines that recycled most of its exhaust signature into the life-support and weapons systems which allowed the cruiser to remain virtually invisible from scanners.
